Prepreg is a high-performance material infused with strong epoxy resin and special fiber tissue, widely used in the aircraft industry and racing for its maximum performance and lightweight properties.With PIM(Premium Integrated Matrix) 2nd generation, HJC utilizes its unique technical expertise, gained through continuous research and development, to laminate the shell. This organized structure enhances impact protection while keeping the weight low, providing greater durability in extreme environments and ensuring uniform stability for improved performance.

• Wind tunnel-tested aerodynamic design shell reduces air resistance & provides stability at high speed.

• "ACS" Advanced Channeling Ventilation System:
Full front-to-back airflow flushes heat and humidity out of the helmet.
2 intakes and 2 exhausts.

• Pinlock Ready HJ-48 Visor: Provides 99% UV protection, Anti-Scratch coated.

• Emergency Kit (cheek pads)
Safe and quick rescue in emergency situation

• Smooth ratchet movement & improved sealing

• Push release visor lock for more secure and convenience.

• Dynamic Multi-Step Sun shield for optimized position.
ANTI FOG COATED
DISTORTION FREE SUN SHIELD (SUN VISOR)

• Interior with advanced anti-bacteria fabric provides enhanced moisture wicking and quick drying function.

• Crown and Cheek pads: Removable and washable.

• Ready for 21B & 50B Bluetooth (sold separately).

• Glasses Grooves Ensure comfort for riders with eyewear

INCLUDED IN THE BOX

• PINLOCK 120 XLT DKS642

• CHIN CURTAIN (installed)

• BREATH DEFLECTOR
